prompt: Add a command `neg` that replaces the top value of the stack with its negation. On an empty stack it is a stack underflow error; when the negation does not fit (the minimum value) it is an overflow error and the stack is left as it was. Errors are reported like those of the other commands.

cases.name: neg-basic
cases.in:
5 neg print
0 neg print
-7 neg print
